# skyhub_ethernet (Resource)

LAN Ethernet port mode (singleton, id `default`). **Changing a value reboots the hub.** When the configured values already match, nothing is sent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Changing these values reboots the hub.
resource "skyhub_ethernet" "this" {
  type = "Gigabit"
  eee  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `eee` (Boolean) Energy Efficient Ethernet.
- `type` (String) `Gigabit` or `Fast`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_ethernet.this default
```
